name: calculator
description: Heavy-weight math engine — no LLM, no eval(). When mathjs is installed (npm install mathjs), supports: arithmetic, exponentiation, factorial (N!), trigonometry (with degrees/radians), logarithms, complex numbers (3 + 4i), rational fractions exact (1/3 + 1/6 → 1/2), matrices (det, inverse, solve), units (5 km/h in m/s), statistics (mean, std, variance, quantile), combinatorics (combinations, permutations, factorial), number theory (gcd, lcm, isPrime, factorize), derivatives (symbolic), simplification, Unicode notation (×, ÷, ³, √, π, ∞), and ~250 functions. Falls back to a built-in numeric parser when mathjs isn't installed. Use this WHENEVER a question involves arithmetic, algebra, calculus, units, complex numbers, matrices, or statistics — even if the user didn't ask for a calculator.
author: aashir-athar
